bio: Greg Lagola is a longtime drum corps and color guard performer, designer, and choreographer, marking his 38th year in the activity in 2018. He joined the Bluecoats in 2013 as a guard choreographer and design team member, and his three-year costume project culminated in the groundbreaking 2016 Bluecoats uniform that reshaped how corps approach costume design; he also designed/choreographed for the Cadets, Santa Clara Vanguard, and the Sunrisers. A New York-based fashion designer and owner of Gregory Joseph, he was inducted into the Bluecoats Hall of Fame in 2022.

Jonny Green is a Southern California marching percussionist, educator, and bass drum specialist with over a decade in the activity. He served as a battery technician with the Troopers Drum and Bugle Corps (2014-2019), bass drum technician at Pulse Percussion (2019-2020), and bass drum technician with the Blue Stars Drum and Bugle Corps (2021-2022), and is currently bass instructor for the Santa Clara Vanguard. He is an educational artist for Innovative Percussion and Zildjian.

Michael B. Raiford (Austin, TX) is a scenic and costume designer for theatre, ballet, and opera who has directed, staged, designed, and choreographed in the marching arts (DCI, BOA, WGI) for over 30 years, with more than 25 National Finals appearances and 8 national titles. In DCI he is currently on the design team and a performance coach for the Bluecoats, and has also worked with the Cavaliers, the Academy, the Troopers, the Glassmen, Magic of Orlando, and Suncoast Sound. He holds an MFA in Design from the University of Texas at Austin, where he taught for 10 years, and is a member of United Scenic Artists Local 829.

Rudy Ruiz marched as a contrabass performer with Pacific Crest (2008-2009) and The Cavaliers (2010-2011). He joined the Pacific Crest visual staff in 2012, rising to assistant visual caption head (2016-2017) and visual caption head (2018-2021), and also taught visual for The Cavaliers from 2013-2015. He has since served as a visual instructor at Phantom Regiment (from 2022) and works as a freelance cinematographer in Los Angeles and Las Vegas.

Tyler Richards is a Northern California native (Leigh High School, San Jose area) who marched color guard with the Sacramento Mandarins, Santa Clara Vanguard A Corps (2006-2007), and aged out with The Cavaliers, later touring as a lead performer in the Broadway show Blast!. He performed four years with the SCV Winter Guard (2008-2011), taught the winter guard (2013-2014), and has been on the instruction and design staff of both Santa Clara Vanguard and Vanguard Cadets since 2019, serving as Color Guard Designer/Lead Equipment Choreographer; he also choreographed for The Cavaliers' 2018 guard. He is based in Indianapolis and directs color guard at Center Grove High School.

Daniel Recoder is a Blue Devils B and Bluecoats percussion alumnus who served as a quad (tenor) technician on the Bluecoats drumline staff (roughly 2014-2019). He has also been associated with the Blue Stars as a health and fitness coach. He currently works as a physical therapist assistant in the San Francisco Bay Area.

Jesus Sanchez is a percussionist and marching-arts educator who has served as Percussion Caption Head for Phantom Regiment (2023-2024 design team) and as Percussion Caption Manager for the Vanguard Cadets (2018). He joined the Vanguard Cadets in 2010 and marched Santa Clara Vanguard (2011-2012) under Paul Rennick, and was a member of the WGI World Champion Riverside Community College winter drumline (2009-2013). His teaching experience includes Troopers Drum and Bugle Corps (2013-2017), Vanguard Winter Percussion, and Pulse Percussion. He holds a Bachelor of Music in Jazz Studies from California State University, Fullerton, completed a Master's in Jazz Studies at the University of Southern California, and performs with the Disneyland Band in Anaheim, California.

Joey Martinez is a percussion educator from Fresno, California, who marched with the Blue Devils 'B' Corps (2008) and aged out as a bass drummer with the Blue Devils (2009-2011), with indoor experience at Sacramento Freelancers, RCC, and Pulse Percussion. He has served as a bass/battery technician for Blue Devils 'B' (2012), Blue Devils (2013), Phantom Regiment (2014-2015), and The Cavaliers (beginning 2020). He graduated from California State University, Fresno with a Bachelor's degree in Business Accounting and teaches percussion at Clovis West High School while also working as a bass technician at Pulse Percussion.

Kevin Welborn is Associate Director of Bands and Assistant Professor of Music at The University of Alabama, holding bachelor's and master's degrees in music education/conducting from the University of Southern Mississippi and a PhD in Educational Leadership from Alabama. In the drum corps activity he marched snare drum with Carolina Crown and Santa Clara Vanguard, then taught percussion with The Cavaliers (2016-2018), served as percussion caption head for the Troopers (2009-2012, staff 2007-2008), and consulted for Memphis Sound (2004-2005). He currently serves as Associate Music Ensemble Coordinator for the Bluecoats.

Lee Beddis is a drum corps percussionist and instructor from Toronto, Ontario, Canada, who marched with the Garfield Cadets, winning DCI World Championships in 1987 and 1990 before aging out. As an instructor he worked with the Madison Scouts, Star of Indiana, and Phantom Regiment (1996 World Champions), and later led percussion for the Crossmen and served as Carolina Crown's percussion caption arranger/supervisor. He served as Percussion Director of the Madison Scouts (2012-2014) and assisted The Cadets in 2015, 2016, 2018, and 2019, and is a Vic Firth and Zildjian marching artist as well as a WGI judge and clinician.
